· Current price (89,395 KRW) vs SMA5/20/50 (102,480/113,821/125,226 KRW) — below short/mid-term trends
· Position vs SMA100 (108,919 KRW) / SMA200 (86,325 KRW) — weakening long-term trend, approaching SMA200

· Swing resistance (89,550 KRW) — near current price, potential for short-term rebound if broken
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low / sideways) — confirming sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.52x vs 5-day average) — surge, adding momentum to downward move
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend) — potential for further decline due to RSI oversold entry and MACD bearish convergence, consider entry after confirming break of 89,550 KRW resistance
